Its value is the direction of the field: cross-contamination causing spurious hyperkalaemia is characteristic of the OPEN (syringe) collection system, whereas with modern CLOSED evacuated systems the order of draw appears negligible. Note the review's included studies pre-date Ercan 2021 and therefore do not capture the non-EDTA, draw-position potassium effect.
